items.title: POST /api/loan-drafts: Unsupported methods
items.body:
1. Test Case ID: HT6Lpu

- Unsupported methods

    TRACE returned 405 without required `Allow` header

    Add `Allow` header listing supported methods (required by RFC 9110)

[405] Method Not Allowed:

    `{"error":{"message":"TRACE is not allowed on this endpoint."}}`

Reproduce with:

    curl -X TRACE -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "Ada Byron", "email": "ada.byron@fairmont.edu", "department": "Design", "purpose": "Studio test shoot."}' http://127.0.0.1:4623/api/loan-drafts
